name: 袭击者空盗船长
description: 成年，约四十岁；身高约185厘米；男性低音，冷硬凶狠，英式英语口音。

variants.appearance: 一名成年男性空盗船长，穿凶悍的空盗首领服装并佩剑。
variants.stage1_prompt:
Air-pirate captain, 40 years old and 185 cm tall, with a brutish frame, thick neck, barrel chest, broad shoulders, heavy arms, and square hands. Angular scarred face, cold deep-set eyes, swept-back close-cropped dark hair, gray temples.

His vintage silhouette comes from a charcoal Victorian naval frock coat with broad lapels, fitted waist, high collar, and long split tails. A deep-red patterned waistcoat and red knotted sash are the only red garments. Blackened iron boarding armor sits over the coat: riveted breastplate, articulated gorget, oversized asymmetrical pauldrons, strapped vambraces, hip guards, knee cops, and heavy deck boots. Brown leather straps and brass buckles secure every plate.

A copper pressure vessel and hand valves power external piston braces at the shoulders and elbows. Exposed ratchets, chain drives, braided hoses, and a hand-cranked back winch keep the machinery visibly Victorian. One forearm carries a brass pneumatic utility grappling launcher with a blunt hook and cable drum; the other has a black iron locking gauntlet. No swords, firearms, knives, or other weapons.

Full-body planted stance on a simplified dockside background.

Complete flat-color 2D production character concept, six-and-a-half-head proportions, crisp varied-width ink linework, opaque flat colors, minimal texture, no lighting, shading, gradients, or painterly rendering.
